name: Ishikawa Goemon
source:
"I like it hot enough to melt."

Based on Ishikawa Goemon, who was a semi-legendary Japanese outlaw hero who stole gold and valuables and gave them to the poor. Goemon is notable for being boiled alive along with his son in public after a failed assassination attempt on the civil war-era warlord Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

Loving manliness and acting on whatever whim takes her, Goemon is a free-spirited hero. She takes good care of others, and is often going from place to place arbitrating disputes.

Her policy of taking from the rich and giving to the poor also makes her popular with the people. She hails from Zipang, but for some reason is now residing in Australia.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char05c]English official site[/url]]
